edit.description: Retire `read_lock_document_for_emit` (`src/drift.rs:2461`) as a second read-and-parse body for one document: its three one-read wrappers — emit's hoisted read (`:1513`), `config_stale` (`:2911`), and `emit_owned_targets` (`:3752`) — route through `read_lock_document` (`:4634`), the pub reader `gate`/`read`/`install` already take. `increment_lock_reads` (`:102`) and `increment_lock_parses` (`:106`) then fire from one place, so a lock lookup counts the same whatever the file's state. Tolerance is kept explicit at each of the three calls, not dropped: a malformed lock must still yield an empty document there — emit heals a corrupt lock by rewriting it, and `config_stale`'s doc-comment states it forges no finding from absent evidence. The malformed-lock counts already agree between the two bodies; only the missing-lock case moves.

New pin beside `emit_lock_parse_is_hoisted_and_pinned_once_per_run` (`:199`), which runs over a lock that exists and so never exercises the uncounted path: emit over a harness with no `.temper/lock.toml` must read and parse exactly once. It reads 0/0 on the pre-fold tree — the vacuity the fold closes — and must be stated as such at the site.
`read_lock_document` call site (`:149`). Touched only if the fold spells the tolerance as a parameter on the one reader rather than at the three call sites; untouched if the signature holds.

summary: Fold the lock's second read-and-count body into one home, so a lockless harness's emit read is counted and the once-per-run pin stops being blind there.

tests.asserts: emit over a harness carrying no `.temper/lock.toml` moves `lock_read_count()` and `lock_parse_count()` by exactly one each; the existing pin over a present lock still reads 1/1.

acceptance: `cargo test` green, no `read_lock_document_for_emit` left in `src/drift.rs`, and the new lockless pin reads 1/1 where the pre-fold tree reads 0/0.
notes: The two bodies diverge only on a missing lock: `read_lock_document` counts one read and one parse, `read_lock_document_for_emit` counts neither. So emit over a fresh lockless harness touches the disk invisibly to `lock_read_count()`, and a per-phase re-read regression on that path leaves the once-per-run pin green — the vacuity bar this cost pin exists to hold. Surfaced by 1d183eb6, which hoisted the neighbouring face onto the gate's already-read document. scoped at e9c6820b
